text: What they do not measure, because their designs contain no mechanism by which an agent’s payoff depends on the verified quality of its work, is: whether the agents’ reports about their work track the work itself; whether agents evaluate one another independently or herd on the visible consensus; whether confident answers are calibrated answers; whether agents contribute to collective evaluation or free-ride on it.
